I would want line plots and box and whisker plots showing temperature for every day of this year for a few key locations around the world (Barrie Ontario, Vancouver BC, Dublin Ireland, Rio de Janeiro Brazil, Dubai UAE, etc), and Box and Whisker plots containing data from 20 or more areas within a 200km radius of each of these locations for each month of the year up until November 1st. My plans later on is to build some theory as to why this happens and understand the applications that could be used for weather control and storm prevention if that is even something that's possible to geoengineer around.
